name: The River Watcher
notes: DRAFT for C13-5 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Blue Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (the scaling guide puts a Guardian at about 90% of the tier max; hits-to-beat in the 40-80 boss band). Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

phases.tell: It pulls its long neck back; red circle.
phases.senseiLine: The neck pulls back first. Ready.

phases.tell: Muddy puddles splash onto the floor.
A striped wave lane and double marks.

lines.intro: The water is muddy. It can't see who you are.
lines.freed: The water is clear. I can see you now, friend.
lines.senseiAfter: You stayed calm in deep water.

description: The River Watcher pecks, splashes muddy puddles that slow you a little, then rolls a striped wave down a lane.

lore.blue: A heron made of water. The shadow muddied its eyes, so it cannot see who is friend or foe. Free it, and its light comes home.
